description: The file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsStore functionality within the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the handling of file identities, allowlist updates, and directory permissions.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsStoreRefactorTests
classes.description: A suite of Swift unit tests for the ExecApprovalsStore component, testing file identity consistency, allowlist management, and permission settings.

methods.name: withTempStateDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for testing, sets environment variables, and executes the provided async closure with the directory URL.

methods.name: ensure file skips rewrite when unchanged
methods.description: Tests that the file remains unchanged if no modifications are made.

methods.name: update allowlist reports rejected basename pattern
methods.description: Checks that updating the allowlist correctly rejects patterns with missing path components.

methods.name: update allowlist migrates legacy pattern from resolved path
methods.description: Ensures that legacy patterns are correctly migrated to absolute paths.

methods.name: ensure file hardens state directory permissions
methods.description: Verifies that the state directory permissions are set restrictively (700).

methods.name: fileIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for a file, such as the system file number.
